mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT M12.MACHINE AS VALUE_COL, '' AS TEXT_COL FROM TB_MAS012 M12, TB_MAS013 M13 WHERE M12.PROC_CD = M13.PROC_CD(+) AND M13.WERKS != 'P100' AND TRIM(M12.MACHINE) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY M12.MACHINE

SELECT DISTINCT MAS031.PLN_YR AS PLN_YR --사업목표년도 , MAS031.PLN_MM AS PLN_MM --사업목표월 , '[' || MAS031.PLN_YR || ' ' || MAS031.PLN_MM || ']' AS PLN_YR_MM --사업목표년월 FROM TB_MAS031 MAS031 WHERE 1=1 AND MAS031.PLN_YR = #{PLN_YR} ORDER BY MAS031.PLN_MM
